issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 11/06/26

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

New Table linkedin

CREATE TABLE linkedin (
     id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    linkedin_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    fullname VARCHAR(255),
    username VARCHAR(255),
    email VARCHAR(255),
    access_token TEXT,
    refresh_token TEXT,
    expires_at DATETIME,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
 );

Update table reviews

ALTER TABLE reviews ADD COLUMN linkedin_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL;
ALTER TABLE reviews ADD CONSTRAINT fk_review_linkedin FOREIGN KEY (linkedin_id) REFERENCES linkedin(id);

LinkedIn Login

Initiates the OAuth2 flow by generating a secure state and redirecting to LinkedIn.

URL: /v1/auth/linkedin Method: GET Auth Required: No

Request

No payload or query parameters required.

Response

Status: 302 Found Description: Redirects the user to LinkedIn's authorization page. Cookies Set:

  • linkedin_oauth_state: A secure, short-lived (10 min) UUID cookie used to prevent CSRF attacks.

Example Usage

Frontend (Browser):

// Redirect the user to start login
window.location.href = "https://api.yourdomain.com/v1/auth/linkedin";

CURL (Testing redirect):

curl -i https://api.yourdomain.com/v1/auth/linkedin

LinkedIn OAuth Callback

Handles the redirect from LinkedIn after user authorization. This endpoint verifies the security state and exchanges the authorization code for user data.

URL: /v1/auth/linkedin/callback Method: GET Auth Required: No (Verified via linkedin_oauth_state cookie)

Query Parameters

  • code (string): The authorization code provided by LinkedIn.
  • state (string): The security state string returned by LinkedIn.

Success Response

Status: 200 OK Payload:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "requestTime": 150,
  "data": {
    "message": "Login successful",
    "user": {
      "id": 1,
      "fullname": "John Doe",
      "username": "john.doe",
      "email": "john.doe@example.com"
    }
  }
}

Side Effects

  • Sets a linkedin_auth HTTP-only session cookie.
  • Deletes the linkedin_oauth_state cookie.

Example Usage

Simulated Request (Internal Testing):

curl -i "https://api.yourdomain.com/v1/auth/linkedin/callback?code=AUTH_CODE_HERE&state=YOUR_STATE_FROM_COOKIE"

(Note: In a real scenario, this is called automatically by LinkedIn redirect)

Get LinkedIn Profile

Retrieves the profile information of the currently logged-in LinkedIn user using the session cookie.

URL: /v1/auth/linkedin/profile Method: GET Auth Required: Yes (Via linkedin_auth cookie)

Success Response

Status: 200 OK Payload:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "requestTime": 50,
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "fullname": "John Doe",
    "username": "john.doe",
    "email": "john.doe@example.com"
  }
}

Error Response (Unauthorized)

Status: 401 Unauthorized Payload:

{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "requestTime": 20,
  "data": {
    "error": "Unauthorized"
  }
}

Example Usage

CURL:

curl -X GET https://api.yourdomain.com/v1/auth/linkedin/profile \
     -H "Cookie: linkedin_auth=1"

JavaScript (Fetch):

const response = await fetch("https://api.yourdomain.com/v1/auth/linkedin/profile", {
    method: "GET",
    credentials: "include" // Crucial for sending cookies
});
const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);

Note for Frontend

Ensure credentials: 'include' (Fetch) or withCredentials: true (Axios) is used to include the session cookie.

Add Review with LinkedIn

Submits a review for a photographer and associates it with a verified LinkedIn account.

URL: /v1/photographers/review/linkedin/:code Method: POST Auth Required: Yes (Via linkedin_auth session cookie)

Path Parameters

  • code (string): The unique review code assigned to the photographer.

Request Body (JSON)

{
  "name": "John Doe",
  "rating": 5,
  "comment": "Highly recommended! The quality of work is outstanding."
}
  • name: Display name for the reviewer.
  • rating: Rating score (1-5).
  • comment: (Optional) Textual feedback.

Success Response

Status: 200 OK Payload:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "requestTime": 200,
  "data": {
    "message": "Review submitted successfully",
    "review": {
      "slug": "photographer-slug",
      "name": "John Doe",
      "rating": 5,
      "comment": "Highly recommended! The quality of work is outstanding."
    }
  }
}

Error Response (Unauthorized)

Status: 401 Unauthorized Payload:

{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "requestTime": 50,
  "data": {
    "error": "Unauthorized. Please login with LinkedIn."
  }
}

Example Usage

CURL:

curl -X POST https://api.yourdomain.com/v1/photographers/review/linkedin/REV123 \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -H "Cookie: linkedin_auth=1" \
     -d '{
           "name": "John Doe",
           "rating": 5,
           "comment": "Highly recommended!"
         }'

JavaScript (Axios):

axios.post("https://api.yourdomain.com/v1/photographers/review/linkedin/REV123", {
    name: "John Doe",
    rating: 5,
    comment: "Highly recommended!"
}, {
    withCredentials: true // Crucial for sending the session cookie
});

Note for Frontend

You no longer need to pass linkedin_id in the body. The backend identifies the user automatically via the linkedin_auth session cookie. Ensure credentials: 'include' (Fetch) or withCredentials: true (Axios) is used.

Context: Implementation spec for the LinkedIn-auth'd review feature — the backend (this Go repo) owns the OAuth flow. Relates to #27 and the breakdown in brainstorm/feedback 11-06-2026/brainstorming.md (§4) / product-doc 202606111126.

Overview

Implement a new authentication system using LinkedIn (OpenID Connect) to allow users to authenticate and leave verified reviews. This includes OAuth2 flow management, profile persistence, and integration with the existing review system.

Proposed Changes

1. Database Schema

  • New Table: linkedin
    • Stores unique linkedin_id (sub), fullname, username, email.
    • Manages access_token, refresh_token, and expires_at for session management.
  • Table Update: reviews
    • Added linkedin_id (foreign key) to associate reviews with LinkedIn profiles.

2. Backend Implementation (Golang)

  • Models: Created Linkedin model and updated DirectoryReview model.
  • Auth Action: Implemented OAuth2 flow with:
    • Dynamic State: UUID-based state stored in HTTP-only cookies to prevent CSRF.
    • Modern Scopes: Using openid profile email.
    • Token Management: Support for token exchange and background refreshing.
  • Controllers:
    • LinkedInLogin: Initiates redirect with state generation.
    • LinkedInCallback: Validates state and persists user data.
    • GetLinkedInProfile: Provides user info based on session cookie.
    • AddLinkedinPhotographerReview: Specifically handles reviews linked to LinkedIn IDs.

3. API Endpoints

Authentication

MethodEndpointDescription
GET/api/auth/linkedinStart LinkedIn Login (Redirects to LinkedIn)
GET/api/auth/linkedin/callbackOAuth Callback (Handles token/profile & sets session cookie)
GET/api/auth/linkedin/profileGet current logged-in user profile info

Reviews

MethodEndpointDescription
POST/v1/photographers/review/linkedin/:codeSubmit a review linked to a LinkedIn account

Implementation Details for Frontend

1. Session Management

The backend uses an HTTP-only cookie named linkedin_user_id to manage the session.

  • Important: Frontend requests to /profile or /review/linkedin MUST include credentials: 'include' (Fetch) or withCredentials: true (Axios).

2. Sample Payloads

Get Profile Response (GET /api/auth/linkedin/profile)

{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "fullname": "John Doe",
    "username": "john.doe",
    "email": "john.doe@example.com"
  }
}

Add Review Request (POST /v1/photographers/review/linkedin/:code)

{
  "name": "John Doe",
  "rating": 5,
  "comment": "Excellent service!",
  "linkedin_id": 1
}

Security Checklist

  • CSRF Protection via dynamic state parameter.
  • Modern LinkedIn OpenID Connect scopes.
  • HTTP-only cookies for session security.
  • Server-side token expiration & refresh logic.

Environment Variables Required

LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_URI=https://yourdomain.com/api/auth/linkedin/callback
LINKEDIN_SCOPE="openid profile email"
